_comment: The application commit this workflow is approved to deploy.
A 40-hex app_sha input establishes SYNTAX, not approval. Every commit on
every branch is 40 hex characters. This file is the approval, it lives on
the default branch, and changing it is a reviewed change.
The candidate checkout never supplies its own approval: this file is read
from the operational checkout (the commit the workflow itself ran from),
never from the application commit under deployment.
Future acceptances are a one-line edit here, reviewed like any other.
packageLabel: Expo package: kiosk link control, truthful email verification state, and station enrolment (a second screen at an event, approved by a Champion, showing exactly what the public display shows). The follow-along player is in this commit but is deliberately NOT routed on staging — see the hosting rewrites.
_expectedPriorFunctionsNote: 31, and the seven that took it there are NOT this deploy's to create. Run 16 (35420410645) created wsfStationRequestPairing, wsfStationPairingStatus, wsfApproveStation, wsfStationClaimPairing, wsfStationState, wsfListStations and wsfRevokeStation, then failed to set their invoker IAM policy and aborted with 'Deploys failed. Skipping deletes.' — firebase creates the service and sets the invoker afterwards, so the services persisted. This is not a guess: run 17 (35420931701) read the live project and its preflight refused with 'the staging baseline has 31 WSF functions but this candidate was approved against 24', before changing anything. The guard did its job; 31 is the true baseline and this line is the reviewed acknowledgement of it. THE SEVEN EXIST BUT ARE NOT CALLABLE: no invoker policy was ever set on them, exactly as happened to wsfGoalRecentAdditions in run 10, which is the same root cause as the standing W2 hosted-verify failure (HTTP 403 on an anonymous call). Deploying this candidate UPDATES the seven rather than creating them, so no invoker set is attempted and the deploy is expected to pass; it does NOT make them reachable, and a green deploy must not be reported as a working station. The fix is an IAM grant on this project and it is the owner's, not this workflow's. wsfGoalPulse keeps its nine-field contract. Reviewed per candidate; the next package will have a different prior count.
